title: Twin musicians join Olivia Rodrigo's new music video
summary:
Singer Olivia Rodrigo has a new music video for a remix of her song "Expectations" with Chappell Roan. It has lots of surprise guests, like musician David Byrne as a game-show host.

Two more surprises are identical twin brothers Jake and Matt Derting. They play in a punk band called Venus Twins. In the video, they are on Rodrigo's team in a game show like Family Feud.

The brothers grew up near Fort Worth, Texas, and now live in New York. A casting agent called them, but at first nobody told them who the singer was. "We didn't even know who it was until literally the night before," Matt said.

They spent about an hour getting spiky punk hairstyles. About 100 people worked on the set. Matt said Rodrigo was "so sweet."

The crew asked them to act like "the mean family." Afterward, Jake said, "We were coming home feeling 10 feet tall."
why_it_matters: It shows that musicians who are just starting out can get exciting chances to work with big stars.

keywords.explanation: A remix is a new version of a song that changes or adds to the original.
Identical twins are two siblings born together who look almost exactly alike.
Punk is a loud, fast style of rock music with a bold look.
A casting agent is a person who finds and picks performers for movies, shows or videos.
A game show is a TV show where people play games or answer questions to win.
